Dairy & Frozen.bestTiming: Morning with breakfast or post-workout to support muscle recovery and steady satiety.
Dairy & Frozen.preparationTip: Enjoy warm or chilled; avoid adding refined white sugar.

Instant Foods.portionTip: Treat one single packet as a full meal rather than an in-between snack, and avoid double packs.
Instant Foods.bestTiming: As an occasional lunch or dinner, preferably not late at night when sodium clearance slows.
Instant Foods.preparationTip: Use 50-60% of the included seasoning tastemaker packet to substantially reduce sodium intake.

combinations.reason: Boosts meal volume, potassium, and dietary fibre which slows down carbohydrate absorption.

avoidWith: Pairing with sugary sodas or heavily salted chips in the same meal.

Snacks & Savouries.portionTip: Pour a single 30g portion (approx. 1 small katori) into a bowl rather than eating directly from the pouch.
Snacks & Savouries.bestTiming: Afternoon snack, ideally alongside a fresh fruit or cup of unflavoured green/black tea.
Snacks & Savouries.preparationTip: Mix 1 part savoury snack with 1 part roasted murmura (puffed rice) or roasted chana to reduce calorie density.

combinations.reason: Hydrating, potassium-rich fresh vegetables help balance dietary sodium and add fresh vitamin C.

avoidWith: Stacking with other high-sodium foods like pickles, papad, or salty processed cheese.

Biscuits & Cookies.portionTip: Limit to 2-3 biscuits per sitting (approx. 25-30g) to control concentrated refined sugar and shortening fats.
Biscuits & Cookies.bestTiming: Mid-morning or evening tea time; avoid eating right before bed.
Biscuits & Cookies.preparationTip: Pair with a hot beverage without added table sugar.

combinations.reason: Provides warmth and liquid fullness without doubling the simple sugar load.

Beverages.portionTip: Limit to a single 150-200 ml glass; avoid supersized bottles or cans in one go.
Beverages.bestTiming: Midday treat, preferably around physical activity rather than sedentary couch time.
Beverages.preparationTip: Dilute 50/50 with sparkling water or plain chilled soda to instantly halve the free sugar concentration.

combinations.reason: Enhances natural refreshing aromatics while keeping sugar concentration dilute.
Dietary fats and plant protein delay gastric emptying, smoothing the liquid sugar spike.

harmReductionDefaults: Sip slowly over 15-20 minutes rather than chugging quickly, to prevent sharp insulin spikes.
avoidWith: Combining with sugary desserts, cakes, or fried snacks in the same sitting.

Chocolates & Confectionery.portionTip: Enjoy 1-2 small squares (15-20g) mindfully, letting each piece melt slowly.
Chocolates & Confectionery.bestTiming: Post-lunch or early evening dessert; mindful sensory consumption enhances satisfaction with smaller quantities.
Chocolates & Confectionery.preparationTip: Store in the refrigerator and snap off a single portion before sitting down.

Health & Nutrition.preparationTip: Shake thoroughly with room temperature or cool water/milk; avoid boiling water which can clump proteins.
